title: Recipe 57 — The advisor loop (mine your own sessions for what to fix)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “The flywheel needs ratings. The advisor needs nothing but the sessions you already ran.”

beats.label: Start from a blank spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — nothing committed is touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env — applying advice through optimize is billed.

groups.title: Beat 1 · a harness with a history

beats.label: Type a harness
beats.cue: “The advisor reads sessions, so first you need something that produces them.”

beats.label: Compile it and check it
beats.cue: “--check: GREEN. Ordinary harness — the advisor is a separate verb, not a spec feature.”

verify.note: GREEN — assertion ok; install ok; boot gated at the provider credentials gate

beats.label: Read the advise contract
beats.cue: “--session for one, --all for the whole history. It reads what already happened; it does not re-run anything.”

beats.label: Open it
beats.cue: “Note -o and --json: the suggestions are a file, so they can be reviewed in a PR like anything else.”

beats.label: Mine every session
beats.cue: “On a fresh harness there is no history yet, so it refuses — and tells you the exact directory it looked in and what to do first.”

verify.note: exit 1 — `no session logs found at <cwd>/.crewhaus/sessions — run the agent first, then advise`

beats.label: Read the refusal
beats.cue: “An advisor with nothing to go on says nothing, loudly. That is the correct empty state — an advisor that invented suggestions here would be worse than useless.”

beats.label: Scan for context pressure
beats.cue: “doctor --context-pressure finds the sessions that were fighting the window — the ones worth compacting or splitting.”

verify.note: reports honestly with no sessions to scan

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Same shape of answer: a diagnostic that admits when it has no data.”

beats.label: Mine ask/deny history into rules
beats.cue: “permissions suggest turns 'you approved this forty times' into a rule you can actually commit.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “The approval prompts you keep clicking through are data. This is what reads them.”

groups.title: One more thing · Step 3 — apply the advice

beats.label: Feed the suggestions to optimize
beats.cue: [needs-key] “--from-advice is the handoff: the advisor proposes, the optimizer proves, and only a measured win lands.”

verify.note: needs mined advice and a model credential; billed on candidate and judge

beats.label: Read the handoff section
beats.cue: “Advice is a hypothesis. The optimizer is the experiment. Never ship the hypothesis.”
